# railway_service (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

### Optional

- `name` (String)
- `project_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `latest_deployment_id` (String)
- `latest_deployment_status` (String)
